method: Actual native Chrome WebGPU inspection of exported GLBs, with the production journey-poster-renderer.js and WGSL. Review harness changes only the submitted yaw uniform for front (0), three-quarter (pi/4), and profile (pi/2); it hides fallback images while native GPU canvases are visible.

observations.all_five_front_profile_three_quarter: Visible, closed silhouettes with no missing front or side faces under real back-face culling.
observations.article: Layered leaves, gutter and rising page turn remain visible; ivory material agrees with the portrait, scroll and brain series.
observations.readiness: Awaited all returned mount promises and submitted first frames, document.fonts.ready and every fallback image decode.
observations.reduced_motion: All five native models remain static after angle input, with zero queued animation frames after initialization settles.
observations.static_fallbacks: All five decoded WebP fallbacks remain visible while GPU canvases are hidden; renderer frame/submission counts stop advancing.
observations.navigation_cleanup: Leaving the gallery destroys all five devices, all fifteen buffers, all twenty-five created textures, all five contexts and pending frames.

review_screenshots: Temporary review captures in /tmp/folio-webgpu-review/screenshots; these working images are not redistributed as runtime assets.
scope: This report validates the model exports and renderer. Integrated journey routing, scrolling, title overlap and retained-page lifecycle are checked separately.
